Desc.SourceString: YOYOYO~这里是<TypingTitle titlename="监狱" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">「格赫罗斯岛」</>说唱之王aka音速次元上帝~
Desc.LocalizedString: Yo yo yo! This is the rap king of <TypingTitle titlename="Prison" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Ghroth Island</>, aka the Sonic Dimension Lord!

Desc.SourceString: 这个beat怎么也这么对胃口？真是没办法啊，那我就再来一段freestyle……
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah, this beat is my cup of tea. Alright, here comes some more freestyle…

Desc.SourceString: ……已经十几首了……你就不能换个安静点的频道？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's been over a dozen songs… Can't you switch to a quieter channel?

Desc.SourceString: 安静？我，就是它命中注定的死敌——安静杀手！沸点魔王！
Desc.LocalizedString: Quiet? I am the destined nemesis of silence—The bringer of cacophony!

Desc.SourceString: 算了算了，看在我也陪不了你多久的份儿上，让你一回——
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, fine, fine. Since I won't be able to keep you company for much longer, I'll let it slide this time—

Desc.SourceString: ……所以<blue>「异能者」</>的超现实能力，有没有可能跟<blue>「异象」</>来源一致呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: So, could it be possible that the supernatural abilities of <blue>Espers</> have the same origin as <blue>anomalies</>?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……「同源说」是学界早有的猜想之一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… The Homology Theory is one of the existing hypotheses in academia.

Desc.SourceString: 通俗来讲就是，异能并非人类自身机能发源的力量，而更像是人类被赋予的力量。
Desc.LocalizedString: Simply put, it suggests that Esper abilities are not powers derived from human functions but rather powers granted to humans.

Desc.SourceString: 至于跟异象的本源是一致还是对抗关系……这一块的研究尚未明晰，只能任君想象了。
Desc.LocalizedString: As for whether these abilities share the same source or are in opposition to anomalies… Still inconclusive…
Oh, how time flies—we're already here—

Desc.SourceString: 你这一下车，我的粉丝可不就又少了一个……
Desc.LocalizedString: Once you get out, I'll have one less fan…

Desc.SourceString: 算了，坐稳了，最后来段Mix轨迹电光量子漂移吧，可不能让你被那帮不近人情的家伙看扁了去！
Desc.LocalizedString: Never mind, sit tight. Let's go out with a bang—Mix Trajectory Quantum Drift! Can't let those uptight folks look down on you!
Thanks.

Desc.SourceString: 哼，算你有良心。今后要是有人欺负你——
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmph, you've got a heart. If anyone ever bullies you—

Desc.SourceString: 算了，谁又能欺负得了你呢。只是你这一走，我的粉丝又少一个咯……
Desc.LocalizedString: Forget it, who could bully you? But when you leave, I'll lose a fan…

Desc.SourceString: 伙计，我这儿还急着写报告啊，你自求多福吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Got a report due! Good luck, buddy!

Desc.SourceString: 这些数字，跟这座城市的异象波动状况有关？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are these numbers related to the anomaly fluctuation in the city?

Desc.SourceString: 对，<blue>「维特海默值」</>——衡量目标对象背离现实浓度的数值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, the <blue>Wertheimer Index</>— measures how much an object deviates from reality.

Desc.SourceString: 持续监测城市各区域维特海默值的变化，我们便能对新出现的异象快速作出反应。
Desc.LocalizedString: By monitoring the changes in the Wertheimer Index across different areas, we can respond to emerging anomalies.

Desc.SourceString: ——半港区的维特海默值波动幅度较为剧烈，收容六组的人，撑不了多久。
Desc.LocalizedString: —The Wertheimer Index in the Halfport strongly fluctuates. Unit 6 won't last very long.

Desc.SourceString: 啊呀，还以为终于能大闹一场了呢……区区Ⅴ级异象……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh man, Just a Class V? I thought I could finally have some fun…
I'll go ahead. See you at the site.
Who's that?

Desc.SourceString: 刚才我碰到了<TypingTitle titlename="禁制机动队" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">E.T.D</>的白藏队长、翳副队和法帝娅前辈！呜呜，还是那么耀眼那么帅气！
Desc.LocalizedString: I just ran into Captain Baicang, Lieutenant Skia, and Fadia senpai! From <TypingTitle titlename="Enforcement Tactical Division" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">ETD</>! Ahh! Could never get my eyes away from them!

Desc.SourceString: 看起来是要出任务的样子……是哪里有异常情况么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like they're heading out on a mission… Is there an anomaly somewhere?

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷，局内保密条例第二条是？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, what's the second article of the Confidentiality Policy?

Desc.SourceString: 是、是那个……呃……不可以打听跟自己工作无关的信息……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's, um… not to inquire about information unrelated to one's work…
Bye, Coco!

Desc.SourceString: 空间异常——启动急变应对条例。
Desc.LocalizedString: Space Anomaly. Initiate Crisis Response Protocol.

Desc.SourceString: 收容组立即核实编号，检查有无收容物解离。
Desc.LocalizedString: Containment Units, ID the unit for containment breach.
Containment breach!

Desc.SourceString: 都看到了。尽快重新收容。
Desc.LocalizedString: I knew it. Recontain it as soon as possible.

Desc.SourceString: 抱、抱歉局长！我马上行动！
Desc.LocalizedString: S-sorry, Director! I'm on it!

Desc.SourceString: 虽说是个低级异象，掉以轻心的话，可是会吃些苦头的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Though it's a low threat anomaly, underestimating it will still lead to consequences.
Hmm.

Desc.SourceString: 难缠的家伙！怎么攻击都没办法泯除的样子，看来还是只能强制收容了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stubborn thing! It won't be nullified no matter how much I attack it, looks like we'll have to contain it.

Desc.SourceString: 不过这么看——还真是怪那个……怪……怪好看的呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: But now that I look at it… it's actually quite… beautiful…
It's been nullified…

Desc.SourceString: 诶——？！这就泯除了？怎么会这样？发生了什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait what?! It's nullified? What happened? How did that happen?
It heard your praise.
Eh, eh? Just because I complimented it?

Desc.SourceString: 可是真的很美呀……这幅画怎么像个老好人似的，也太好说话了吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: But it IS beautiful… This painting is almost too easygoing… Such a softy!
Thank you, Mr. Picture Frame!

Desc.SourceString: 它存在的理由……或许，只是想得到一句真心诚意的认可吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe all it sought in existence was a sincere compliment.
Nunya business.
Hello?
Over here!
Hello?
Hey! Over here!
Put the book back.

Desc.SourceString: 按我，要找人就按我……记得不要太用力！
Desc.LocalizedString: Press me. If you're looking for someone, press on me… but not too hard!

Desc.SourceString: 舟车劳顿，请先稍作休息，我去给两位准备茶水。
Desc.LocalizedString: Please feel free to take a break, you've had a long journey. I'll prepare some tea.

Desc.SourceString: 阿德勒先生有办法解除我们当前的状态吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Adler, is there a way to undo our current state?

Desc.SourceString: 这小房子做得真精致诶……
Desc.LocalizedString: (Wow) This little house is so delicate… (Heh)
Mint…!
Huh?

Desc.SourceString: 对不起！对不起阿德勒先生！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, Mr. Adler!

Desc.SourceString: 是我的失误，没有将「好客屋」妥善放置，薄荷小姐不必自责。
Desc.LocalizedString: It was my mistake for not placing the Hospitable House properly. Mint, please don't blame yourself.

Desc.SourceString: 阿德勒先生有办法解除我们当前的状态吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Adler, is there a way to undo our current state?

Desc.SourceString: 「好客屋」会将打开屋门时的在场之人缩小，便于进入屋内参观。目前来看，我们只能等待七分钟后的自行解除。
Desc.LocalizedString: The Hospitable House shrinks those entering through the door for convenient indoor tours. We'll return to normal in seven minutes.

Desc.SourceString: 呼——看来是个友善的异象！事已至此——它这么热情，那我们就进去参观下吧！阿德勒先生，可以吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew… looks like it's a friendly anomaly! Since we're here—its hospitality deserves a tour! Mr. Adler, may we?
I'd be happy to accompany you.

Desc.SourceString: （赖床浔！塔吉多叫不醒！还是叫不醒！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hotori is still in bed! Still asleep!)

Desc.SourceString: （一级警报！蟑螂出现！蟑螂出现！浔讨厌蟑螂！塔吉多也讨厌！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Alarm level one! Cockroach alert! Cockroach alert! Hotori hates cockroaches! Taygedo hates them too!)

Desc.SourceString: ……稍稍有些麻烦了，参观者处于缩小状态，在别人眼中通常会呈现为一些……不太招人喜欢的东西。
Desc.LocalizedString: We have a slight problem. When shrunken, we appear as rather… unwelcome things to others.

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多好像把我们当成了蟑螂……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo seems to think we're cockroaches…?

Desc.SourceString: 啊？我才不要当蟑螂！我这就把塔吉多打晕！
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? I don't want to be a cockroach! I'll knock Taygedo out!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷小姐，当前我们的力量跟体型一样，都被弱化过了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, our strength is also reduced.

Desc.SourceString: 诶——？那岂不是只能在杀虫剂下坚持完剩下的几分钟了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Eh—? So we can only endure the remaining minutes under bug spray…

Desc.SourceString: 最后一击——决一胜负吧，小海獭！
Desc.LocalizedString: Final blow—let's settle this, little otter!

Desc.SourceString: ……一大早就哐啷哐啷吵死了……塔吉多你在干嘛？
Desc.LocalizedString: All this racket early in the morning… Taygedo, what are you doing?

Desc.SourceString: 可恶，昨晚就不该把最后一瓶也喝了……解酒药……解酒药在哪儿来着……
Desc.LocalizedString: Darn, shouldn't have finished that last bottle last night… Where's the hangover medicine…

Desc.SourceString: 哪儿来的脏东西？！给我死！
Desc.LocalizedString: What's this dirty thing?! Die!

Desc.SourceString: 这位是新加入的鉴定师，伊波恩的古董鉴定就靠{Gender}|gender(他,她)了！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is our new appraiser, Eibon's antique evaluations depend on {Gender}|gender(him,her)!

Desc.SourceString: 今后就麻烦大家了，我会认真工作的。
Desc.LocalizedString: From now on, I'll do my best.
Hehe, I'll watch your back!

Desc.SourceString: 有了鉴定师，浔总算可以少收点假货了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: With an appraiser, Hotori can stop buying fake goods, right?
You little brat!

Desc.SourceString: 我再来依次介绍下吧。我和塔吉多主要负责店里的古董维护和生活后勤。
Desc.LocalizedString: Allow me to properly introduce everyone. Taygedo and I handle antique maintenance and logistics.
(Sorry about earlier!)

Desc.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔小姐负责店内与四周的安全事务。
Desc.LocalizedString: Daffodill is responsible for security.
Hello.

Desc.SourceString: 娜娜莉、早雾和埃德嘉，店里承接的低级异象事件大部分由他们外出处理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nanally, Sakiri, and Edgar handle most of the low threat Anomaly cases.
Hello.

Desc.SourceString: 手上没什么工作的时候，可以跟我们一起行动！
Desc.LocalizedString: When there's no work, you can join us!

Desc.SourceString: 什么嘛，我们又不是处理不了……哼，当然啦，如果你想见见世面，也不是不可以带上你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Not that we need the help… but if you wanna be amazed, you can come along

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，我对异象事件也很感兴趣。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm. Anomaly cases interest me too.
And this is Hotori, the owner of Eibon—

Desc.SourceString: 负责每天酩酊大醉！好酒……好酒……干杯！
Desc.LocalizedString: In charge of getting drunk every day! "Cheers, I'll drink to that."

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多给我抓住她！晚饭加十颗海胆——我要教训这个小矮子！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo, grab her! Ten urchins for dinner—I'm teaching this little one a lesson!

Desc.SourceString: 收工，找老板结账然后拍照~
Desc.LocalizedString: Time to wrap up, let's get paid and take our photo.
(Taygedo is great at posing!)

Desc.SourceString: 埃德嘉、早雾，拍照的时候允许你们轮流亲吻我的左手！
Desc.LocalizedString: Edgar, Sakiri, you can take turns kissing my left hand for the photo!
Uh…
No way!
Come on, come on—

Desc.SourceString: 明晃晃挂只怪鸟在这里，简直就是在说「快来抓我我很可疑」嘛——
Desc.LocalizedString: A glaringly obvious bird hanging here, practically screaming, "Catch me, I'm suspicious"—
Catch it!

Desc.SourceString: 站住！你们都不准出手，这只臭鸟，看我怎么抓住它！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop! No one else touches it. This annoying bird, I'm gonna catch it so hard!
You… stay still! Don't run!

Desc.SourceString: 这是什么？我们之前来调查都没有看到这东西！果然冬司的失踪是和这个异象有关吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's this? We didn't see this during our previous investigation! Toshi's disappearance must be connected to this anomaly!

Desc.SourceString: 抱歉……我也没有查到这个异象的资料。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sorry… I couldn't find any data on this anomaly.

Desc.SourceString: 连我的智囊团第一人都不知道这个异象？你脑袋里可是装着一个图书馆诶！
Desc.LocalizedString: Even the brainiac doesn't know? You've got a whole library in your head!
Hey!
Puke—

Desc.SourceString: 这个东西！怎么又被你吞进去了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my gosh! Why did you swallow that again?!
Gone. It's gone…

Desc.SourceString: 鬼郎丸自有办法！……哎哟！痛！早雾！好痛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Kiroumaru knows what to do! Ahh! My tummy! Sakiri! Help!
Urgh!

Desc.SourceString: 它这——又是在生哪门子气啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Why is this thing angry again?

Desc.SourceString: 应该是觉得它的主人也被吃掉了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe it thinks that… Kiroumaru ate its master, too…
Ha… haha…

Desc.SourceString: 咳咳咳咳……咳咳咳咳……这、这是哪里……
Desc.LocalizedString: Cough, cough… cough, cough, cough… Wh-what is this place…?
Woof!
Dan-Dandelion?
Woof! Woof!

Desc.SourceString: 是蒲公英！我就知道是你！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's Dandelion! I knew it was you!

Desc.SourceString: 蒲公英，这段时间你到底跑到哪里去了你这只坏狗！呜呜呜呜……我怎么都找不到你……吓死我了呜呜呜呜………
Desc.LocalizedString: Dandelion, where have you been, you bad doggy! *Sniffles* I've been looking for you… Aw, you really scared me soulless!
Thank you for getting here in time.

Desc.SourceString: 客气，这一路也辛苦你照顾娜娜莉他们。
Desc.LocalizedString: No need for thanks. I appreciate you taking care of Nanally and the others along the way.

Desc.SourceString: 蒲公英，你怎么会跑来这么远的城市啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Dandelion, what are you doing here so far away from home?

Desc.SourceString: 还好遇见了好心人一路照顾你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank God you had all these nice people taking care of you along the way.

Desc.SourceString: 车快到了，这次我们应该没落下什么吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: We're almost there. Did we forget anything this time?
Woof!
Uh… Anomaly… R-3707… in breach…
Watch out!
Eh…?

Desc.SourceString: 好端端交着手，它突然生什么气啊喂！
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything was fine, why did it get angry all of a sudden!
Mint!
Coco, over here!
Three,
Two,
One—
Here it comes!

Desc.SourceString: 让你见识见识我的秘密招式吧——
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me show you my secret move…

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷霹雳无敌托马斯回旋——————
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint's Super Duper Ultra 360…
Whirlwind Slash!
Anybody here?

Desc.SourceString: 从局里去伊波恩不算太远，累的话可以在车上休息一会儿，到了我会叫醒你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not far from here to Eibon. If you're tired, you can rest in the car. I'll wake you up when we arrive.
Mhm.

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，在这里碰到，可真是缘分呐~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, look who it is! Lucky me, running into you.

Desc.SourceString: 喂喂，怎么一脸困惑？难道……已经不认得我了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, what's with the confused face? Don't you recognize me?
Uh… Captain Baicang?

Desc.SourceString: Bingo~我就知道，你不是那么冷漠绝情的人呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Bingo! I knew you weren't that cold-hearted.
Uhm…

Desc.SourceString: 那孩子……是不是有什么想说的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is he… trying to say something?
(Break free.)

Desc.SourceString: （如果你那么想，就用自己的声音，告诉我你的名字。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Show your will, tell me your name, in your very own voice.)
(I will save you.)
…I'm Maiyue…
Please help me!…

Desc.SourceString: 表达得很好，听得很清楚喔。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well done. I heard your every word.
Now, fade at once, nameless being…
Well done.

Desc.SourceString: 很神奇呀，就像「秋天」提前到来了一样不是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't it weird? It's like fall came early, you know?

Desc.SourceString: 装神弄鬼的家伙！交易？我的愿望可不是那么便宜的东西！
Desc.LocalizedString: Creepy psychic fraud! A deal? My wish is worth a lot more than that!

Desc.SourceString: 像您这样不由分说上来就动手的客人，本店可是……会感到困扰的啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: People who punch instead of talk aren't really… welcomed here… Ah…
Is he carrying the invitation?
Yes, he is.

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没有感应到奇点的存在么？
Desc.LocalizedString: No signs of the nexus here either?

Desc.SourceString: 完成「替换」后，别忘了告诉哈索尔。
Desc.LocalizedString: After the swap, don't forget to tell Hathor.
Hmm?

Desc.SourceString: 哈索尔，要遵守交通规则哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hathor, be sure to obey the traffic laws!

Desc.SourceString: 不是，现在的狗仔，都开雷加利亚玩跟踪的？
Desc.LocalizedString: Paparazzi can afford Regalia these days?!

Desc.SourceString: 嘿——今天就让你瞧瞧，什么叫真摇滚！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey—today, I'll show you what real rock is!
Turn on the nitro!
Engage flight mode!
Bidding 1 Fons.
And Sold!

Desc.SourceString: 哇，舞会吗？是不是只要和它们共舞一曲就能下班了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, a dance party? Does that mean I can skedaddle after one dance?

Desc.SourceString: 它们在跳华尔兹？你不会想上去跳宅舞吧……？
Desc.LocalizedString: They're doing the waltz? You're not planning to break out a nerdy dance, are you…?

Desc.SourceString: 跳什么舞不重要，带着诚意跳，才是重要的！
Desc.LocalizedString: The dance doesn't matter, it's the heart that counts!

Desc.SourceString: 诚意不够的话，我还能边跳边唱！
Desc.LocalizedString: If that's not enough, I can sing while I dance!

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅，看来——你的反向预言生效了哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel, looks like—your reverse prophecy worked.
…Eh?

Desc.SourceString: Ⅴ级异象「永不谢幕的阿拉克涅」，运气不佳啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Class V anomaly, The Never-Ending Arachne. Tough luck!
See! I told you!
Uh… sorry…

Desc.SourceString: 好在它的行动模式比较固定，算Ⅴ级异象中不算太难处理的那类。
Desc.LocalizedString: Good thing it's predictable, one of the easier Class V Anomalies to deal with.
Then let's dance.
Boss… this isn't a sci-fi game…
Boss… we don't have that feature.
Wowza!
Could it be… are you Taygedo?
(Oh no, oh no, oh no… What to do what to do?!)
Whoa…
Boss! So this is where you've been…!

Desc.SourceString: 只带两个保镖外出太危险了，请随我们回去！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's too risky with only two bodyguards! Please, come back with us!
(You guys…)
(Hmph… Enough chatter! No interruptions today!)
(Everyone, make way for Taygedo!)
Uh, yes! Boss!
Wooow!
Hee…
(Phew…)
(Dear Tako, it's a pleasure to meet you…)

Desc.SourceString: 塔吉多！比咱想象的还要酷！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taygedo! You're even cooler than we thought! (Hehe)

Desc.SourceString: 哟哟哟！瞧瞧瞧瞧，这是哪位啊？
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, well, well! Look who we have here!
Well well well, see who's the big shot here.
Tayge?!

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，伊波恩的幕后老大——塔吉多！你这种活在海特洛市的黑暗面……从不抛头露面的家伙，今天怎么这么有闲情逸致？只带这么几个人就敢出门逛街呢哈？
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh heh, if it isn't Taygedo, the big boss behind Eibon! You're always skulking in Hethereau's shadows… What's the occasion, Mr. Never-Shows-His-Face? Feeling brave enough for a stroll with just a handful of goons, huh?

Desc.SourceString: 怕是不清楚……你们在外头招惹过多少势力、结过多少仇家了吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I bet you've lost count of all the big shots you've ticked off and the enemies you've made out there, huh?

Desc.SourceString: 咦……总觉得好像，在哪里见过？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh… Why do I feel like I've seen them before?
(Ugh… Of all the people to run into!)
(Taygedo will protect Tako with all his might!)

Desc.SourceString: 嘁，还以为吹的是什么风，原来是有了那种「弱点」啊~挺俗套的嘛~
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch, and here I thought it was something special. So it's just that kind of "weakness," huh? More cliche!

Desc.SourceString: 这不正好？就将他所有重要的东西，都在他面前摧毁到稀巴烂好了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Perfect timing! Let's smash everything he cares about to bits, right in front of his eyes!

Desc.SourceString: 不好意思……我们在拍戏……请谅解……
Desc.LocalizedString: Excuse me… We're filming a scene… Please understand…

Desc.SourceString: 小小海獭~做好觉悟吧！在场有这么多人——将会一同见证你的陨落！
Desc.LocalizedString: Listen up, little otter… You better brace yourself! With all these people here, they're about to witness your epic downfall!

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族誓必重新支配海特洛市！你的时代就在这里宣告终结！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Coluccis swear to rule Hethereau once again! Your reign ends here and now!
(Hmph, oh really!)
Ugh! I can't believe it… I lost…

Desc.SourceString: 柯林斯家族的未来，就、交给你了……
Desc.LocalizedString: The future of the Coluccis… is in your hands now.
…You're taking this way too seriously! (Breath with slurping sound)
Haha, oops! My bad, my bad!
Are you alright?
No way, not a chance!
No way. Seriously?

Desc.SourceString: 咳。塔吉多老爷惜才，不想为难你们，走吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ahem. Sir Taygedo values talent and doesn't wish to make things difficult for you. You may go.

Desc.SourceString: 啧！……臭海獭，别以为就这样算了！这仇我们总有一天会报的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch! …Listen here, you slimy otter! Don't think you're off the hook! We'll get our payback someday, mark my words!

Desc.SourceString: 一年份的咕比奇薯片！别忘了哈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't forget my one year supply of Gubichi!
Huh? Gubichi?
(This…)

Desc.SourceString: 这是我们组织斗争中使用的暗语。意思是……会去开启新的人生。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a code phrase we use in our organization's operations. It means… to start a new life.
(Yes, that's it! Exactly!)
I see.
(Oh no…!)

Desc.SourceString: 为了不耽误我们的行程，看来得请老爷和塔可小姐……姑且低调一下了。
Desc.LocalizedString: To avoid any delays in our journey, I'm afraid I must ask Sir Taygedo and Miss Tako to… keep a low profile for now.
(Taygedo proudly presents a special performance!)
Woah!!
Tayge!
It's us!

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多……居然能做到这种地步吗？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo… can actually do something like this?)
Ta… Ta…
(This! For Tako!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔、塔吉多想要告诉……塔可小姐……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ta-Taygedo wants to tell… Tako…)
Taygedo… uh, huh?
Ta?
(Whawhawhat's going on!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔、塔吉多想要告诉……塔可小姐……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ta-Taygedo wants to tell… Tako…)

Desc.SourceString: 不是？刚刚不还好好的吗！发生什么事了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wasn't everything okay? What in the world happened?!

Desc.SourceString: 等下、鬼郎丸，不准吃！给我吐出来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold it right there, Kiroumaru! Don't you dare eat that! Spit it out now!

Desc.SourceString: 糟了……难道是塔吉多的能力，促成本是异象的「随心泥」失控了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no… Could Taygedo's ability have caused the Imaginadough to spiral out of control?
Eek!
Miss Tako, look out!
Boss!
Boss!
Boss!
Boss!
Boss!
Boss!
What's going on here?
Settling scores in broad daylight?
They're not about to throw down, are they?
Quick, call the Security Office!

Desc.SourceString: 是谁在这里闹事堵塞交通？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who's causing this commotion and blocking traffic?
Whoa!
Look, quick!
That's amazing!
Hey, hey…
Ah…
Is it moving?
Ahhhhhh! Stop right there!

Desc.SourceString: ※本画面经过塔吉多幻想滤镜处理
Desc.LocalizedString: ※Image does not represent reality

Desc.SourceString: （就用自己的声音，告诉我你的名字。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Tell me your name, in your very own voice.)
(Appraiser… Appraiser…!)
What's wrong, Taygedo?
(Help! Help me, Appraiser! Help me! Help me!)
Nngh… it hurts…
(The bat… it's talking…)
No… Not time yet…
Five… Five more minutes…
(Bat, became a person!)
Ah. TV… Talking…
Lacrimosa senpai!
Lacrimosa senpai! Where are you?
Is that Mint?
Coco!
Quiet as a mouse… quietttt…
(Stay hidden! Quiet!)
Hungry…
Ah, senpai! wait up!
Tomato jelly…
…Eh?
(It's gone…)
You gotta pay first! You can't just take it!
…I kind of get why the public misunderstood now.

Desc.SourceString: 这个东西！怎么又被你吞进去了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my gosh! Why did you swallow that again?!

Desc.SourceString: 呃……前辈她偶尔会出现这种小意外……
Desc.LocalizedString: Uh… senpai tends to have these little… accidents sometimes…
Lacrimosa… didn't mean to.

Desc.SourceString: 事后、事后都会照价赔偿的……
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll pay—we'll pay for everything later, I promise…

Desc.SourceString: 亲爱的市民朋友们，这里是18时的新西里安市。根据气象部门最新监测数据，我市即将迎来今年首个特大暴雨预警……
Desc.LocalizedString: Dear citizens, this is the 6 PM broadcast from New Helios. According to the latest data from the Meteorological Department, our city is about to face the first extreme rainstorm warning of the year…

Desc.SourceString: 这里也没有感应到奇点的存在么？
Desc.LocalizedString: No signs of the nexus here either?
It's beautiful!
Look, quick!

Desc.SourceString: 要暴雨了，别看了先回家吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Storm's coming—let's head home before it hits…
Is that a… Phenomenon Anomaly?

Desc.SourceString: 没见过这么好看的异象！
Desc.LocalizedString: I've never seen an anomaly that stunning!

Desc.SourceString: 一会儿下雨了不会看不到了吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Will it be gone when the rain starts?
Quick, record it and post it on Bagel!

Desc.SourceString: ……请市民朋友们务必注意安全，做好防范措施，无必要不出门……
Desc.LocalizedString: …Please stay safe and take proper precautions. Avoid going outside unless absolutely necessary…
Hm?

Desc.SourceString: 接下来关于各区详细雨量分布……插播一条紧急消息，我市上空疑似出现……
Desc.LocalizedString: Now for detailed rainfall distribution by district… Uh—breaking news. There appears to be a possible—
Ahh!
What's happening?!
This isn't rain!
S-Something's wrong!
Run!

Desc.SourceString: 这里是J.T.F十三队，NH19区域搜救任务已完成。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is JTF Team 13. Search and rescue in Sector NH19 is complete.

Desc.SourceString: 区域内异象活动显著增强，正在加速转移已搜救幸存者。
Desc.LocalizedString: Anomaly activity in the area is intensifying. We're trying to evac the recovered survivors ASAP.

Desc.SourceString: 收到，二次封锁即将启动，请根据最新安全路线迅速撤离。最新安全路线为……
Desc.LocalizedString: Copy that. Second lockdown is about to commence. Evacuate immediately via the updated safe route. Current safe route is—Prequel Street…
Hello? …Hello?!
You hear that? That sound…

Desc.SourceString: 信号有干扰！什么声音？我听不清！
Desc.LocalizedString: Signal's breaking! What sound? I can't hear it!
ETD Squad 4 and…@^%(^ are en route to…@^%

Desc.SourceString: 你听！你仔细听！这个声音……这个声音……啊……啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait! Listen! That sound… that sound… ah… ah…

Desc.SourceString: 糟了！拦住他——！黑盒面罩！绝对不能摘下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Damn it! Stop him—! Don't let him take off the Black Box Mask!
Hurry!
Hold him down!

Desc.SourceString: 要我……要我举目直视……要我看清——！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: It wants me… It wants me to see clearly…!

Desc.SourceString: 一定记住，不要让任何人直视「极漩」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everyone, do not look directly at the Hypervortex.

Desc.SourceString: 说得那么可怕，别吓坏了这些小可怜们——
Desc.LocalizedString: You make it sound so terrifying—don't scare these poor dears.
Look at it. Isn't it gorgeous?
Ah… a lovely little appetizer.
Lacrimosa. Protect the others.
Mm.

Desc.SourceString: 留我们在这里过家家，白藏那家伙呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Leaving us with the boring stuff here… Where's Baicang?

Desc.SourceString: 「极漩」出现的三个半小时起，新西里安城区的维特海默值开始回升——它的确在自然泯除。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over three hours since Hypervortex emerged, the Wertheimer Index in central New Helios is rising—natural nullification is in effect.

Desc.SourceString: 继续搜索「奇点」，没有把握，不要轻举妄动。
Desc.LocalizedString: Continue the search for the Nexus. Do not act rashly.
Something's up.

Desc.SourceString: ——是「环」的人吗？在这里是做什么？
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone from the Circle…? What are you doing here?
What am I… doing here…?
Don't look at that thing!
It's… right there.

Desc.SourceString: ……刚刚好的角度？这么绝佳的观景点，你是怎么找到……
Desc.LocalizedString: …That perfect angle? How'd you find such a prime viewpoint… Huh?

Desc.SourceString: 监测到「极漩」的泯除速率突然加快，尽快弄清是什么情况。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nullification of the Hypervortex has suddenly accelerated. I need to know why.

Desc.SourceString: 发现「奇点」咯……越是盯着那个核心，泯除越快？
Desc.LocalizedString: Found the Nexus… I guess the more you stare at its core, the faster the nullification?

Desc.SourceString: 「不可直视的异象」……还真是脆弱得令人意外。
Desc.LocalizedString: The anomaly that you can't look at… Surprisingly fragile.
Stop interfering… Stop interfering…
What… are you?
What… am I…
Careful!

Desc.SourceString: 突发状况，新西里安市再次出现未知异象。
Desc.LocalizedString: Bit of an emergency. Another unknown anomaly just appeared in New Helios.
Yikes… this one's a problem.
The time… has come… stop interfering…

Desc.SourceString: 一同被泯除了么……伴生……不……
Desc.LocalizedString: Nullified…? Part of a surge…? Hm… Well…

Desc.SourceString: 看来——得麻烦你，跟我回去一趟了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like you're coming with me.

Desc.SourceString: 又或是想等父母找到这里来，把他们拉下水一并吞噬……
Desc.LocalizedString: Or were you thinking of waiting for your parents… to come for you…

Desc.SourceString: 在这个全新的家园里其乐融融……手牵手和外面的社会说再见？
Desc.LocalizedString: and build your lovely family here, hidden away from the rest of the world?
Mhm.
Here we go!
A newbie?
First time meeting.
What's going on?
Did something go wrong?
Oh no—
A rookie after all.
…Eh?
What's that…?
Destroy! Destroy!
Crush! Crush!
It's you.
You…
Come again!
Such arrogance!
Master!
Is that—it?
Daffodill!
…Zankou.
It's not over yet.
Who exactly are you?

Desc.SourceString: 以后，要记得早点睡觉，多吃蔬菜。我的小花瓣要健康、快乐地长大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Remember to get to bed early and eat your veggies. My little petal needs to grow up healthy and happy.
Mom…? Where are you going…?
Don't forget Mama after you grow up, okay?

Desc.SourceString: 生活究竟是什么……这个问题的答案，就交给你去寻找了。
Desc.LocalizedString: What is life… Promise me you'll find the answer for me, okay?

Desc.SourceString: 究竟要怎样「活着」，生命的意义究竟是什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: How exactly should one live, and what's the meaning of life…

Desc.SourceString: 这个问题的答案，就由你在接下来的生命中去寻找，好吗？这是我、哥哥姐姐们，我们一家共同的愿望，共同的期许……
Desc.LocalizedString: You must find out the answers in the life ahead of you. Promise me. This is the shared wish of your brothers and sisters and myself… our whole family's hopes and dreams…
I… don't need you anymore.
Mom?
Mom?... Mom??

Desc.SourceString: 都是我……！都是因为我，妈妈才会……！！！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's all my fault…! It's all because of me that Mom—

Desc.SourceString: 看，现在我能——永远活下去了哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: See? Now I can live for—ev—er!
Mom? Don't go…!

Desc.SourceString: 我们已经等你很久、很久了，蕾妮。
Desc.LocalizedString: We've been waiting for you for a long time, Renee.

Desc.SourceString: 还记得吗？我们「诞生」于此的缘由……和我们与生俱来的使命。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you remember? The reason we were born… and the purpose we must serve.

Desc.SourceString: 一切热闹终将归于虚无，母亲对此早已疲惫、麻木。
Desc.LocalizedString: All excitement will eventually fade to nothing. Mother has long grown tired and numb to it all.

Desc.SourceString: 于是，我们因母亲炽烈的心声苏醒，来到她的身边……
Desc.LocalizedString: We thus awoke to the blazing call of Mother's heart, and came to her side…

Desc.SourceString: 我们以此身立誓，母亲将永远不再孤独……
Desc.LocalizedString: We swore with our very existence that Mother would never be alone again…

Desc.SourceString: 在「孩子」们的簇拥下，母亲得到了她渴求已久的陪伴与幸福……
Desc.LocalizedString: Surrounded by her "children," Mother found the companionship and happiness she had longed for…

Desc.SourceString: 但她没有停下……她仍在渴求更多，因为我们未能满足母亲内心深处真正的愿望……
Desc.LocalizedString: But she didn't stop… She kept yearning for more, because we weren't able to satisfy Mother's deepest wishes in her heart…

Desc.SourceString: 然而，母亲的愿望没有实现，也永远不会有实现的那天了……
Desc.LocalizedString: However, our mother's wish was never fulfilled, and that day will never come…

Desc.SourceString: 那最后一个苏醒、最受宠爱的孩子，却为母亲、为这个家带来了诅咒、背叛与毁灭……
Desc.LocalizedString: That last child to wake up, the most beloved of all, brought nothing but curses, betrayal, and destruction to Mother and this family…
And now… she's back.
It's you.
Daffodill!

Desc.SourceString: 就是这家伙吗，放马过来！
Desc.LocalizedString: So that's it, huh? Bring it on!
Now's not the time to let your guard down!

Desc.SourceString: 一亿？！怎么不按剧本来啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: One hundred million?! How could you do that!
Looks like victory goes to me!
Destroy! Destroy!
Crush! Crush!
This bear must… w-w-warn you…!
Careful! The bear is transforming!
What in Hethereau…? YUCK!
Finally revealing your true nature…?

Desc.SourceString: 熊要告诫你……为小孩子操心的人都会招致不幸……
Desc.LocalizedString: This bear must warn you… worrying about kids only brings forth misfortune…
Just like you! HAHAHAHA!
Cursed humans…
All those who abandoned teddy bears…
Adler? Where are you?
That ferry… is sailing on the land?

Desc.SourceString: 从何而来……又将……成为什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: From where we come… to where… we go?

Desc.SourceString:
浓雾渐渐起，小舟隐隐现；
旧梦声声来，烦恼快快去；
无忧又无虑，何必趄趄行？
渡你，渡我，渡世俗；
如今，往后，别再念。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The fog rolls in, the ferry appears
Old dreams come calling, troubles fade away
No more worries left to carry, not a reason left to delay
Ferry you, ferry me, ferry the world along
From this day forward, let it all be gone

Desc.SourceString: （欢迎泥~欢迎泥~能康到船船的客人~！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Henlo, henlo, guest who can see the ferry!)

Desc.SourceString: 扭扭？居然在这里也能看见你们这群小家伙。
Desc.LocalizedString: I didn't expect to see you little guys here.

Desc.SourceString:
浓雾渐渐起，小舟隐隐现；
旧梦声声来，烦恼快快去；
无忧又无虑，何必趄趄行？
渡你，渡我，渡世俗；
如今，往后，别再念。
Desc.LocalizedString:
The fog rolls in, the ferry appears
Old dreams come calling, troubles fade away
No more worries left to carry, not a reason left to delay
Ferry you, ferry me, ferry the world along
From this day forward, let it all be gone
What's that?

Desc.SourceString: （太阳。不升起，不落下。没有黑夜，没有晨曦。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Da sun. No rise, no set, no morning, no night.)
Fog,

Desc.SourceString: 与黑羽小姐的占卜对上了，这里应该就是娜娜莉走丢的异象空间。
Desc.LocalizedString: These all match Blackbird's divination. This must be the Anomalous Realm Nanally got lost in.

Desc.SourceString: 出于什么原因只有我一个人进来了……得先告诉大家。
Desc.LocalizedString: For some reason I'm the only one here… I need to tell the others.

Desc.SourceString: 出了点意外……伊波恩的那个鉴定师也进去了。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a problem… the Appraiser from Eibon got in too.
An opportunity…
How fun.

Desc.SourceString: 听到了吗？任务再拖下去，你的两个「伙伴」都得永远留在里面了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you hear that? Act fast, or two of your "companions" will be stuck there forever.
You…
Hmm?

Desc.SourceString: 我说过，东西我会拿到。这与他们无关。
Desc.LocalizedString: …I already told you I will get the target. This has nothing to do with them.

Desc.SourceString: 可不推姐姐一把，怎么知道这「第二次的衷心」是否真诚~？
Desc.LocalizedString: How would we know you're committed this second time if we didn't have leverage, sis?

Desc.SourceString: 亲爱的，有些花在断过根后才能长得更美。相信你能回应我的信任。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dear, some flowers blossom further after their branches are broken. I trust that you'll make it up to me.

Desc.SourceString: 但如果姐姐也被关在里面，出不来了怎么办？
Desc.LocalizedString: What if our dear sis gets trapped inside too?
Don’t worry.

Desc.SourceString: 我必须出来，因为我还有必须要做的事。
Desc.LocalizedString: I need to get out. There are things I need to do.
No more… running… away…

Desc.SourceString: 意识体开始转变了。好！果然无需泯除，她自己就可以——
Desc.LocalizedString: The projection is changing. Yes! We don't have to nullify her to—
Daffo… dill?
Ugh… ahhh…
Thyme's projection was nullified!?
Appraiser…
Nanally!

Desc.SourceString: 任务完成得不错。达芙蒂尔。
Desc.LocalizedString: You did your job well, Daffodill.
Leave it to me.

Desc.SourceString: 四十二、四十三、四十四、四十五、四十六、四十七、四十八……
四十二、四十三、四十四、四十五、四十六、四十七、四十八……
四十二、四十三、四十四、四十五、四十六、四十七、四十八……
我们已经等你很久、很久了，蕾妮。
Desc.LocalizedString: We've been waiting for you for a long time, Renee.

Desc.SourceString: 还记得吗？我们「诞生」于此的缘由……和我们与生俱来的使命。
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you remember the reason we were "born"… and the purpose we must serve?

Desc.SourceString: 度过漫长而孤寂的时光之后，她的心中酝酿着一个愿望。
Desc.LocalizedString: After enduring long and lonely times, a wish began brewing in her heart.
I don't want this…!!!

Desc.SourceString: 看，现在我能——永远活下去了哦？
Desc.LocalizedString: See? Now I can live for—ev—er!
I… don't need you anymore!!!
I wonder when she dies…
I won't let you do this!
…she'd be just as charming?
How nostalgic…
Sister.
As you… wish!
We'll meet again…

Desc.SourceString: 另外，「母亲大人」也很想念你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just so you know, "Mother" misses you too…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……你现在这副表情……我很喜欢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… That look on your face… I like it!
So you're the one behind all this!

Desc.SourceString: 是这个小可爱让你分心了吗。
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this little cutie distracting you?
You're slower.
Hmph… interesting.
Unfortunately… this is the end.
Cower before me!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……你现在这副表情……我很喜欢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm… That look on your face… I like it!
All at once?
Tick-tock tick-tock… Aren't you running out of time?
Daffodill.
I'm fine…
Watch out!

Desc.SourceString: 对了果果，给你拿着，你来丢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Right, Taya, take this. Throw it!
Umm… like this?

Desc.SourceString: 没错没错！那么这次奇幻游戏之旅——
Desc.LocalizedString: That's right! Now, let our fantasy adventure—
—officially begin!

Desc.SourceString: 你是谁……？这一次，你想当怎样的人？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who are you…? What kind of person do you want to be this time?
Huh?
What is…?

Desc.SourceString: 大概是我们的职业，什么的吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: I think it's something like our class.
AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!!
Huh?!!
Why do I look like this…?
What shenanigans are you up to?

Desc.SourceString: 节选自噗卡乐园工作日志：本次茶点准备工作出现疏漏，导致章鱼先生临时改用茶杯充饥。对此造成的不便，我们深表歉意……咦我茶杯呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Excerpt from the Pukaland Work Log: Due to a minor catering oversight, Mr. Octopus was forced to snack on a teacup instead. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused… Wait. Where's my teacup?

Desc.SourceString: 温馨提示：如果感到自己还在旋转，甚至海特洛也开始旋转，请先确认是否已离开甜蜜大摆圈。
Desc.LocalizedString: Friendly reminder: If you still feel like you're spinning—or Hethereau itself starts spinning—please make sure you've actually stepped off the Punchulum Ride.

Desc.SourceString: 据体验者描述，这场「圆舞会」的地点比预计高了不少，疑似看见空中怪象。乐园方表示，以上仅为体验效果，如果在空中看到别的东西，记得：不要回答！不要回答！不要回答！
Desc.LocalizedString: Visitors report that this particular "waltz" took place much higher than expected, with several unusual sights spotted in the sky. Pukaland assures all guests that this is perfectly normal and absolutely part of the experience. If you see anything else up there, remember: Do not answer. Do not answer. Do not answer.
